How to Play
Objective: Drag and drop sets of three random block shapes onto the 8x8 grid to fill complete horizontal or vertical lines.
Clearing Lines: Completed rows and columns disappear immediately, earning you points and freeing up board space.
No Rotation: You cannot rotate the shapes; you must plan your spatial layout carefully to avoid running out of room.
Game Over: The round ends when the grid fills up and no new shape can fit.
